verdict.rationale: Zero is explicitly open-source and self-hostable, with GitHub docs stating 'Self-Hosting Freedom – Run your own email app with ease' and a probe confirming a real, keyless-cloneable source tree with docker-compose files for self-hosting the full mail pipeline (DB, prod services). This gives a switcher genuine control over their own instance rather than relying on a hosted SaaS. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting setup/migration docs (e.g. IMAP/SMTP backend specifics), independent hands-on reports of a completed self-hosted deployment, and confirmation of full mailbox portability beyond Gmail/Outlook OAuth integration.
